1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Astronomical Book (1 Enoch 72-82) (c. 250 BC)

'And the names of the sun are the following: the first Orjarēs, and the second Tomāsē. And the moon has four names: the first name is Asōnja, the second Eblā, the third Benāsē, and the fourth Erā' — the named luminaries. Tewahedo angelological tradition preserves the pattern of NAMED celestial beings (rather than impersonal forces): every star has a name known to Uriel and revealed to Enoch, just as every soul has a name known to its guardian angel — the personal-not-impersonal cosmos.
